commit 9deeeff6bb03066383cf1636bbe8eac519bde557
Author:     Kai Engert <kaie@kuix.de>
AuthorDate: Sat Jul 18 10:14:02 2026 +0000
Commit:     toby@thunderbird.net <toby@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Sat Jul 18 10:16:06 2026 +0000

    Bug 2055931 - Fix libEGL filename suffix used by installer on macOS. r=tobyp
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D312802

diff --git a/mail/installer/package-manifest.in b/mail/installer/package-manifest.in
index a2cd11d6e48..2a8b567a7e5 100644
--- a/mail/installer/package-manifest.in
+++ b/mail/installer/package-manifest.in
@@ -142,11 +142,15 @@
 ; We don't have a complete view of which dlls to expect when doing an artifact
 ; build because we haven't run the relevant parts of configure, so we guess
 ; here and trust what came from our source build.
-#if defined(MOZ_ARTIFACT_BUILDS) && defined(XP_WIN)
+#ifdef MOZ_ARTIFACT_BUILDS
+#ifdef XP_WIN
 @BINPATH@/vcruntime*.dll
 @BINPATH@/msvcp*.dll
-@BINPATH@/libEGL.dll
-@BINPATH@/libGLESv2.dll
+#endif
+#if defined(XP_WIN) || defined(XP_MACOSX)
+@BINPATH@/libEGL@DLL_SUFFIX@
+@BINPATH@/libGLESv2@DLL_SUFFIX@
+#endif
 #endif
 
 ; Optional RSS extension
@@ -352,8 +356,8 @@
 
 ; ANGLE GLES-on-D3D rendering library
 #ifdef MOZ_ANGLE_RENDERER
-@BINPATH@/libEGL.dll
-@BINPATH@/libGLESv2.dll
+@BINPATH@/libEGL@DLL_SUFFIX@
+@BINPATH@/libGLESv2@DLL_SUFFIX@
 #endif # MOZ_ANGLE_RENDERER
 
 #ifdef MOZ_DXCOMPILER
title: Bug 2055931 - Fix libEGL filename suffix used by installer on macOS. r=tobyp
